description: This Java source file defines the BaseRpcService class implementing RpcService interface, providing methods for managing RPC entities such as save, delete, find, and batch removal, with logging and validation.

classes.name: BaseRpcService
classes.description: Service class implementing RPC management functions, including CRUD operations and batch deletions, with logging and validation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an Rpc entity using rpcDao.

methods.name: deleteRpc
methods.description: Deletes an RPC by tenantId and rpcId after validation.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity cast to Rpc.

methods.name: deleteAllRpcByTenantId
methods.description: Removes all RPCs associated with a tenant.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an Rpc by tenantId and rpcId after validation.

methods.name: findRpcByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an Rpc by tenantId and rpcId.

methods.name: findAllByDeviceIdAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves paginated RPCs for a device filtered by status.

methods.name: findAllByDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated RPCs for a device.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity as Optional, based on EntityId.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity as Optional.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is RPC.
